title: FOCUS: Benchmarking Retinal Model Generalization from Foundation Vision Encoders to Multimodal LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating max-minus-min gaps in predictive performance metrics (demographic parity, accuracy, equal opportunity, false-positive rate, equalized odds, and AUROC) across binarized age subgroups (split by the median valid age) on retinal disease classification tasks.

Measuring differences in predictive performance and fairness metrics (demographic parity, accuracy, equal opportunity, false-positive rate, equalized odds, and AUROC) between male and female patient subgroups on retinal disease classification tasks.
